description: Transaction receipt on Sei (eth_getTransactionReceipt): success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in SEI, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use sei_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x51ee2bca2ed878b0f576071a0cd21c0f8f129d4de4a545c5a7b3511fa6d048bb. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: sei_receipt
title: Sei transaction receipt
